title: Run.CueRaised
description: The payload of a cue at a worktree run's gate (topic troupe.core.runs.aggregate:Run.CueRaised): an open request to a role a person holds, to approve or reject the run's changes, with a brief that makes sense without the run's other events. At most one. The run's changes wait until the role answers.

lineage.description: Where the event came from. It names the performance the run is a step of.

role.description: The role the cue is for.

brief.description: What the role needs to answer: whose run it was, how it ended, what it changed and where the diff is, and why the cue came to this role.

actor.description: The actor whose run it was.

diff.description: The diff's artifact reference, as the run's end recorded it.

added.description: How many files the diff adds.

modified.description: How many files the diff modifies.

deleted.description: How many files the diff deletes.

after.description: The pass that brought the cue here. Absent: the role was first in the run's approvers.

files.description: The files whose part of the diff doesn't apply to the working tree, relative to the theatre.
